exposure: mild cholestasis (initial total bile acid [TBA] <40 mmol/L and peak TBA <40 mmol/L)
progressive cholestasis (initial TBA <40 mmol/L and peak TBA >=40 mmol/L)
outcome: cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracing
cohort: The study included 1,182 singleton, non-anomalous gestations complicated by cholestasis delivered at a single academic medical center from 2005 to 2019.
finding: Both progressive and severe cholestasis were significantly associated with a composite adverse outcome when compared to mild cholestasis, and progressive cholestasis outcomes were found to be more similar to severe cholestasis than mild cholestasis.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery for nonreassuring fetal heart rate tracing was included as part of the composite adverse outcome assessed in the study.
